name: review-dbt-diff
description: Read-only, diff-scoped reviewer for dbt model changes — twelve defect checks derived from the target repo's own fix history (grain, join cardinality, incremental coherence, NULL semantics, CDC ordering, contract drift), row-count deltas against production, evidence-rung grading, an Act-On cap of five with a visible Dismissed section, and a committed dismissal log that learns which patterns the owner keeps overriding.
